data.cultural_impact: The name Bisalesh is an auspicious and prestigious name in Hindu culture. It signifies good fortune, wealth, and prosperity. It is believed that people with this name possess a lucky aura. The name is often seen in ancient Hindu texts and is recognized as a holy and blessed name in various Hindu communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Bisalesh is a profound spiritual name, symbolizing the presence of divine blessings and Lord's protection. It represents wisdom, knowledge, and strength. The name serves as a constant reminder of the Lord's guidance and blessings, providing the bearer with a strong spiritual foundation, and inner peace and happiness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bisalesh: God of infinite wisdom and abundant wealth. Symbolizing the pursuit of spiritual knowledge and material prosperity.

historical_references.reference: Bisalesh was a sage mentioned in the 13th century Jain text 'Sarvavatsuputra-sutra'. He was a contemporary of Mahavira and is known for his renunciation and attainment of Kevala Jnana.
Bisalesh is also mentioned in the 11th century Hindu scripture 'Skanda Purana'. He is described as an incarnation of Lord Shiva who took birth to destroy a demon named Dhenuka.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Bisalesh' is from Hindu mythology, referring to a god or demon known for his dual nature, often depicted as having two faces or two bodies. In modern contexts, this name has gained popularity across various platforms. On manga and anime, Bisalesh is sometimes used as a character name, representing the dichotomy of good and evil. On YouTube, there are videos featuring Indian mythology and Bisalesh is a popular search term. In video games, Bisalesh can be found as a character in some Indian-themed games or as an easter egg reference to the Hindu god.
